description: This Java source file defines the 'LogFragment' class, a fragment component for Android that displays log data using a LogView inside a ScrollView. It sets up the UI elements, configures visual styles, and handles text change events to auto-scroll to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays logs within a scrollable view, providing methods to initialize UI components and access the LogView.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and configures a ScrollView containing a LogView, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates the view hierarchy for the fragment, sets up a text change listener to auto-scroll, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
